Guskant, [http://photon.freeshell.org/ whose existence is created by works created by herself], is maybe Japanese speaker and is Lojban person, who is involved in singing, too.

== Acting as Mankant ==
[[Image:mankant.svg|thumb|100px|Mankant]]
Guskant pretends to be Mankant <ref>Mankant is not ''manquante'' but '''manku kantu''' according to [http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dark_energy dark energy].</ref>, who is servant of [[la bripre|Bripre Jikca]], by wearing glasses, moustache and a cap.<br />
Guskant think that she perfectly looks like Mankant, and that nobody is aware that Mankant is Guskant,<br />
but Bripre actually knows that Mankant is identical to Guskant.

== Creating Zantufa ==
Guskant is typically in favor of modifying Lojban grammar,<br />
while she also strongly dislike unfairness,<br />
and therefore she doesn't want to encounter any texts that include [https://groups.google.com/d/topic/lojban/FY2m4kqJ_tg/discussion la'oi, zo'oi or me'oi].<br />
However, [https://web.archive.org/web/20151031175123/https://mw.lojban.org/papri/La_Bangu La Bangu] and the not-bad-to-her [https://web.archive.org/web/20151127105727/http://mw.lojban.org/extensions/ilmentufa/camxes-exp.html Ilmentufa] include the above mentioned unfair parts of speech.<br />
As a result, many people from #lojban IRC and beginners use that abominable-to-her parts of speech in their texts.<br />
She doesn't want to be concerned with those "extreme right people who expel Polynesians" described by her.<br />
Motivated by that, she decided to move to an independent small island of [[zantufa|Zantufa]], <br />
though anyone who doesn't use that abominable-to-her parts of speech is welcome by her to the island.<br />
The recent version of Zantufa [http://guskant.github.io/gerna_cipra/zantufa-1.9999.html is found here].<br />
Sadly, [https://vimeo.com/190637628 some people expelled her from Lojban community,] and therefore her small island maybe does not belong to Lojbanistan. In any case, she maybe succeeded in moving to the island.<br />
'''Good luck to Zantufa.'''
